title: La mano a me date
subtitle: Despina, Don Alfonso, Ferrando and Guglielmo: quartet from Così fan tutte, Act 2 (No. 22)

passages.label: La mano a me date · Perdono vi chiede
Non può quel che vuole · Su via, rispondete · Per voi la risposta
Quello ch'è stato (Rezit.) · A me porgete il braccio
Per carità, partiamo (Presto, to the end)

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 4, No. 22 Quartetto

licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (pò!; un schiavo; lasciavi; scordiamci; nè; Ferrando's and Guglielmo's echoes “tace,” and “in pace,” without the libretto's ellipses).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 229–235, bars 1–91 of No. 22
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges, pp. 229–232 and 233–235), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by two fresh checkers (clean); the marks sweep also removed staccatos in bars 5–6 that are not printed. The German singing translation is left out. Allegretto grazioso in 6/8; Allegro in 4/4 at bar 51, with Despina's recitative (Rezit.) from bar 52 and a tempo at bar 55; 6/8 again at bar 60, Tempo I at bar 61; Presto in 4/4 from bar 71. Fermatas at bars 42, 43 and 60. Playback tempo: Allegretto grazioso ♩ = 105 (a dotted quarter = 70), Allegro ♩ = 132, Tempo I ♩ = 105, Presto ♩ = 200, fitted to Jacobs (2:18); Mozart gives the words only.
